A real ducktape view component, used by the tests that need a valid
`ducktape:view@0.1.0` artifact without building one.

Source: this checkout, crates/views/members (package members-view).
Build:  make views      # ops/build-views.sh, release, wasm32-unknown-unknown,
                        # then `wasm-tools component new`
Copy:   target/views/members_view.wasm -> view.component.wasm
SHA-256: 36ad3a6e029e1ef6c08f32abd307384f02ccc9b7ed2145d5e2bd095fd9480c5a

It carries the `ducktape.view.manifest` custom section holding
`ducktape.view.manifest.v1` text, which is what the readiness and
view-registration tests read. members-view is here only because it is the
smallest view in the set; any view works, so re-copy from whichever one is
smallest if this ever needs refreshing, and update the digest above.

`ops/build-views.sh` pins the path prefixes and the target dir, so the bytes
are reproducible from this checkout — regenerating does not need an external
toolchain.
